goal: Roadmap item 6: accessibility pass (skip link, one shared focus ring, card arrow on keyboard focus, one ring in forced colors, strict axe, 24 px targets)
outcome: shipped on 863efa2 if merge.mjs lands PR #17: Lens, Probe and Iris (advisory, 7.5/10) said ship on 863efa2; CI check and scope green; page at rest pixel-identical to origin/main

went_wrong.what: The contract's file scope ('nothing else in page.tsx') made C8 unbuildable: Contact links were 21 px tall. Probe caught it before the build; decision 4 widened the scope

The skip link skips nothing: main wraps the whole page including the header, so Enter then Tab lands where Tab alone would. The contract's stated reason (reach Contact without tabbing the cards) is not met
Production is unreachable from the cloud sandbox (proxy CONNECT 403), so every 'compare with production' step fell back to an origin/main build

proposed_setup_changes.change: Allow theseus-portfolio.vercel.app through the cloud environment's network policy so Iris and Probe can compare against production as the rubric and contracts ask
proposed_setup_changes.moves: sprints whose production comparison fell back to an origin/main build: 1 of 1 cloud sprints that tried (sprint 4)

follow_ups: Quill: give the skip link something to skip (a banner landmark outside main, or a target past the project list), or decide it is convention only; tick item 6 on ROADMAP.md

Probe: C5/C6 in a11y.spec.ts tab until any project link, then inspect a fixed card index; breaks once a second project has an href (review-lens.md nit 2)
